immediate_care: Isolate the animal from the rest of the herd as a precaution.
Monitor temperature and appetite twice daily.
prevention: Maintain clean housing and fresh water.

immediate_care: Provide clean water and easily digestible feed.
Keep a symptom log with dates and times.
prevention: Restrict movement of other animals in and out of the shed.
avoid: Do not mix this animal's milk/produce with the general supply.
Do not self-medicate without vet guidance.

immediate_care: Isolate the animal immediately and limit all contact.
Contact a veterinarian as soon as possible — do not wait.
Keep the animal warm, hydrated, and calm while waiting for the vet.
prevention: Quarantine the whole affected group if more than one animal shows symptoms.
Disinfect the shed, equipment, and footwear before/after entry.
Report to local veterinary authority if outbreak is suspected.
avoid: Do not move the animal to a market or shared grazing area.
Do not delay veterinary contact hoping symptoms resolve on their own.
